summary: Comprehensive testing of StageHand Practice Mode feature. All audio upload/delete/streaming endpoints working correctly. Frontend UI for Practice Track upload and Teleprompter Practice Mode fully functional.
passed_tests: POST /api/songs/{song_id}/audio - Audio upload endpoint (MP3, WAV supported)
DELETE /api/songs/{song_id}/audio - Audio delete endpoint
GET /api/audio/{filename} - Audio streaming endpoint
Audio upload returns 404 for nonexistent song
Audio upload returns 400 for invalid file type
Audio delete returns 404 when no audio exists
Audio streaming returns 404 for nonexistent file
Path traversal prevention in audio streaming
Songs have audio_file field in API response
Full upload → stream → delete flow works correctly
Song Editor - Practice Track section visible for existing songs
Song Editor - Practice Track section NOT visible for new songs
Song Editor - Audio player shows when track is uploaded
Song Editor - Delete audio button (X) works
Teleprompter - Practice Mode toggle in settings panel
Teleprompter - Shows '✓ X of Y songs have practice tracks' count
Teleprompter - Audio player bar appears when Practice Mode enabled
Teleprompter - Shows '♪ Track loaded' for songs with audio
Teleprompter - Shows 'No practice track for this song' for songs without audio
Teleprompter - Mute toggle button visible and functional
Teleprompter - Music icon appears in song navigation for songs with audio
critical_code_review_comments: Audio file storage in /app/backend/audio_files/ is working correctly
Path traversal prevention is implemented in backend code (checks for /, \, ..)
File size limit of 50MB for practice tracks is enforced
Supported audio formats: MP3, WAV, M4A, MP4, OGG, FLAC, AAC
Audio file cleanup on delete is working (file removed from disk and DB field cleared)
